## About
Lx Mobile tire shop & wheel fix is a mobile tire service based on SW 21st Ter in Miami. Instead of you getting to a shop on a flat, we drive out to wherever you are and get you back on the road.
Neighbors tend to call us when things go wrong at the worst time, late in the evening or when a nail ends up in a tire. Reviewers often mention Richard by name, along with quick replies by phone and text and fair pricing.
We're grateful to hold a 5 star rating from 418 Google reviews, and we'd like to be the number you keep on hand.

## Services
- Patch it up: If a nail or puncture leaves you stuck, we can patch it so you can get home safely.
- Flat tire help: Got a flat? We come out to where you are and take care of it.
- Right tires, installed: We help you get the right tires at a fair price and install them on site.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We're open 24 hours, every day of the week, Monday through Sunday.

Q: Do I need to bring my car to you?
A: No. We're a mobile service and come to your location.

Q: How do I get in touch?
A: You can reach us by phone or text, and we'll get back to you quickly.
